picks.title: OpenAI has bought AI personal finance startup Hiro
picks.why_it_matters: Signals OpenAI's expansion into vertical AI applications, validating AI-native fintech as an acquisition target and potentially closing the window for standalone personal finance AI startups.

picks.title: No company in American history has ever grown like Anthropic
picks.why_it_matters: Anthropic's unprecedented revenue scaling reinforces the massive platform opportunity in foundation models and suggests enterprise AI spending is accelerating faster than any previous tech wave.

picks.title: Slate Auto raises $650M to fund its affordable EV truck plans
picks.why_it_matters: A significant late-stage round in climate tech shows continued investor appetite for EV infrastructure plays, particularly in the underserved affordable vehicle segment.
